canonical_title: The Second Philip K. Dick MEGAPACK
author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: A modern digital anthology (2015) collecting a batch of Dick's early public-domain stories, reflecting his 1950s preoccupations with illusory realities and the strangeness beneath suburban life.
page_summary:
The Second Philip K. Dick MEGAPACK is a 2015 ebook anthology, part of a series that repackages public-domain science fiction for digital readers. It gathers a run of Dick's early short stories—work from the 1950s whose copyrights have lapsed, making it available for inexpensive collected editions.

The stories here belong to the same seedbed as his better-known work: quick, idea-driven tales in which the ordinary surface of life gives way to something uncanny, and the domestic and suburban turn uncertain. They show Dick as a working magazine writer, testing premises about perception and reality at speed.

As a modern compilation rather than an authorial collection, the MEGAPACK matters mainly as an accessible on-ramp to Dick's early short fiction, and as evidence of how his 1950s output continues to be recirculated for new readers decades later.
